results.description:
He found her, freed her heart, body, and soul, but can he keep her?
 

Travel writer Daisy Blanchard discovers the worst news ever.
 

Her boyfriend is now engaged to her best friend!

To add insult to injury, she learned about the unholy union through a Facebook status update.
 

Yet Daisy escapes her life in shambles by taking a last-minute assignment to Martha's Vineyard, where she immediately catches the eye of a sexy and possessive billionaire named Belmont Lord. And he wants her—he wants her with an obsessive desire. But is Daisy ready to betray her broken heart and dive into the most sensual journey of her life?

Find Her, Keep Her: A Steamy Martha's Vineyard Love Story is the first addictive, steamy romance in the Steamy Destination Romance Series by bestselling author Z.L. Arkadie. This book is for mature readers and ends happily ever after; it can be read as a standalone.
